summary: Frontend-only Expo/RN web preview tested end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). Verified all 8 composition bands (n=3,5,7,10,12,15,20,30) match spec exactly, deal flow (name-input->see-card->hide-card, deal-progress), dashboard (VIVO badges, role-reveal modal, start-night label), night steps (Lobos + Caçador per-hunter, picker excludes self, confirm disabled before selection), day summary + vote flow, Lobos win condition triggered correctly at end, and localStorage persistence across a same-page reload (resumed on dashboard). No React Native red screens, no deprecated packages detected in reviewed files.
critical_code_review_comments: engine.ts checkWin: matches spec exactly ('others < wolves' triggers Lobos, wolves==0 triggers Aldeia).
roles.ts getComposition: bands are correct with upper bound inclusive (<=5, <=10, <=15, <=20, else band5).
engine.ts expandTwins loops until stable so twin-death chaining is correct even for vote/hunt.
GameContext.assignNext calls linkTwins only after the final player is dealt - this is fine since Gémeos are only added when n>=11 and comp has exactly 2 twins.
night.tsx picker pools correctly exclude the acting player (Caçador, Profeta, Dentista) and exclude dead players since `alive` filter is applied.
day.tsx vote picker uses `state.players.filter(alive)` so dead-from-night are excluded from voting.
Storage persistence via useEffect on state - restart resumes at correct route via routeFor map in index.tsx.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All game-logic checks (composition per band, twin chaining, profeta reveal, dentist silence banner, protetor protection path, multi-hunter steps, dead-exclusion from pickers, Lobos win condition, persistence via reload) verified. If retesting, note that browser tool uses a fresh context per invocation, so persistence must be tested via page.reload() within the same session. n=3 game run produced Lobos win correctly (Lobo attacks non-wolf on night 1, then Caçador misfires, then village votes off the remaining Caçador -> wolves=1, others=0 -> Lobos win).
